body.text:
pinned to the wall with a scalpel:

if you have a fever DO NOT go to him. he can smell it. the fever is his invitation

stages. learn them:
1 warm. you feel fine. YOU ARE NOT FINE
2 sick. weak. two hours in
3 coughing. loud. everything hears you. four hours
4 you fall down. six hours. then you get back up and you are not you

the red pills cure it. pharmacy, floor supervisor's safe. there were two left when I wrote this

I have a fever. I am going to the elevator. if a doctor in a beak mask asks after me tell him I died
